text:
Situation: Caspofungin acetate 7 mg/mL, 10.8 mL vials are at 326 units on hand, covering 20.2 days at current usage. FDA's drug shortage list does not include caspofungin acetate as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): Two manufacturers have posted discontinuations on the FDA list. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted on 2026-01-12. Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. posted on 2026-06-30.

Our position: Current inventory is limited. Multiple alternative manufacturers remain available and are not on the FDA shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fosun Pharma USA Inc. (ranked option 1); requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Gland Pharma Limited (ranked option 2); requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC (ranked option 3); requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Sagent Pharmaceuticals (ranked option 4); requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Sandoz Inc. (ranked option 5); requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock reaches critical levels.
